jobs.title: Service Project & Tender Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation, commissioning and maintenance of high-power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency.  In this role, you will take ownership of driving and implementing the service sales strategy, identifying new business opportunities, and ensuring strong commercial outcomes across the full contract lifecycle. You will play a key role in developing competitive proposals, structuring contracts, and ensuring alignment with customer requirements, internal policies, and technical standards. Working at the intersection of sales, legal, finance, and engineering, you will contribute to sustainable business growth while optimizing both financial and operational performance. How you'll make an impact Drive and execute the service sales strategy while monitoring performance, identifying market trends to develop new business opportunities, and leading contract and proposal jobs.title: R&D Internship for Magnetics Design in Power Electronic Converter Systems 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we closely collaborate with business areas to develop foundations for the next generation of Power Grids products. Located in the proximity of Zurich, the research center employs more than 60 scientists from all over the world with cross-disciplinary expertise. In the Systems Integration and Physics Team we address the challenges and opportunities in enhancing grid flexibility and facilitating renewable energy proliferation. A key focus of our work is multi-physics modeling for power electronic systems, which plays a critical role in fast-growing applications such as electric vehicle charging, energy storage and renewables like wind and solar. In this context, we offer an 6 months internship position which provides the opportunity of working on real-world projects in an international team of research scientists. How you'll make an impact Extension of a MATLAB-based tool for systematic and comprehensive design and optimization of magnetic components in power electronic converters Design and comparison of different winding types Design and comparison of different core materials Implementation and testing of models. Documentation of studies and results in technical reports Adaption of the code architecture as necessary to maintain clarity and facilitate easy maintenance Collaboration with an international research team and experts in power electronics    Your background Enrolled in a Master degree program in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer sciences, or a similar discipline (completion of at least six semesters) Experience with MATLAB programming Familiar with magnetics in power electronic converters Enthusiastic, motivated and curious with good organizational skills and team spirit Highly conscientious professional with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent communication skills Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of the Material Sustainability pillar, aligning methodologies for environmental impact assessments, defining processes, implementing initiatives, and monitoring progress across the business unit. This is your opportunity to align with business objectives and regulatory requirements, supporting the organization's sustainability goals and making a meaningful impact in the energy industry. How you will make an impact Contribute to the development of the business unit's supply chain sustainability strategy, focusing on material sustainability and alignment with business objectives. Monitor emerging material sustainability trends, regulatory changes, and customer requirements, integrating them into strategic and operational plans. Develop standardized process flows for material sustainability requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and effective implementation. Identify opportunities to enhance material sustainability, driving projects such as decarbonization efforts and improving practices with key global suppliers. Implement performance monitoring systems to track progress against material sustainability goals, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement. Develop and maintain a comprehensive database of primary sustainability data for materials, ensuring accurate information and promoting adoption across the supply chain. This includes defining the data needed to enable consistent LCA\/EPD\/PCF assessments and comparable material-level impact evaluations. Engage with suppliers and cross-functional teams to guide strategic suppliers toward emission-zero goals and sustainable practices. Develop and deliver training on material sustainability topics, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and best practices across the SCM community. Align the BU Transformers methodologies for assessing material environmental impacts in line with evolving LCA\/EPD standards. Apply these methodologies to transformer-relevant materials and decisions by defining measurable requirements for suppliers and by supporting internal stakeholders with actionable guidance for material choices, claims, and customer requests. Your background Degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in supply chain management with focus on sustainability, with proven leadership in strategy and roadmap creation, preferably within global or large-scale organizations. Strong expertise in materials sustainability standards such as ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, the Greenhouse Gas Protocol, and related frameworks. Extensive experience with Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), and implementing global sustainability programs related to materials and suppliers. Strong leadership skills with a track record of developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex, international environments. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and inspire change at all organization levels.

jobs.title: Internship in Computational Chemistry 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The design of high voltage (HV) devices, such as gas circuit breakers (CB) and gas insulated switchgear (GIS), requires – among others –simulations and experiments for verification of insulation and switching performance. Additionally, the research activities in the area of gas circuit breakers are enhanced by various computer-aided-engineering tools. We are looking for an intern student with expertise in computational chemistry to contribute to the development of novel insulating materials for high-voltage power grid applications. The superior goal is the achievement of high-end quality of the product. The duration of the internship is 6 to 12 months.    How you'll make an impact  Contribute to technology development and research activities focusing on material analysis and characterization  Support simulations of gas insulation systems using state of the art computational chemistry packages  Study the relationship between microstructure and material characteristics and document findings and present test results to the team    Your background B.Sc. degree in Material Science, Chemistry, Physics or similar discipline with focus on computer-aided methods  Programming skills and experience in computational chemistry is an advantage  Fluency in written and spoken English  Team player and well organized  Creative and able to work autonomously  Laboratory and experimental experience is a plus  More about us We are a technology‑driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. How you'll make an impact Analyze emerging domestic and international security threats and provide timely assessments and advisories. Deliver competent security support across the country\/cluster, ensuring alignment with regional security standards and KPIs. Ensure compliance through audits, inspections, and monitoring of evolving security legislation. Provide expert security risk management advice to support key business decisions. Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives. Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance. Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting. Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background Min. 5 years Advanced education and significant experience as a security specialist. Proven expertise in threat intelligence, risk analysis, and crisis management. Strong understanding of security standards, legislation, compliance requirements, and audit processes. Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization. Business fluent in German and English. Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination. Ability to operate in a global matrix environment and manage responsibilities across multiple countries. Approx. 30% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Internship in Reliability Testing for SiC-based Power Semiconductors
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our Semiconductor Packaging and Reliability Engineering research team and contribute to next‑generation power electronics. You will work on silicon carbide semiconductor reliability in a dynamic research environment. The role focuses on developing and improving innovative testing solutions for power devices. You collaborate closely with experts and gain insights into real research challenges. You will grow by combining experimental work with data analysis and system development. This position offers hands‑on access to advanced laboratories and close cooperation with industry and academia. How you'll make an impact Conduct measurement campaigns and analyze reliability data of SiC devices Develop and improve test setups for dynamic reliability testing Design solutions for advanced sensing and automated data collection Optimize power converter systems for long-term testing Upgrade measurement electronics and data acquisition systems Support integration of monitoring systems for device aging Document and communicate results within research and business teams Your background Currently enrolled in a Master's program in physics, electr onics   engineering , materials   engineering   or a related discipline (official enrolment is essential) Familiar with   electrical measurements setup   and with   the design and construction of electronics systems .   Previous   experience with semiconductor physics and\/or power devices is a strong plus Experience with LabView programming, and knowledge of programming languages ( e . g.   Python, C ,   Matlab ) Fluency in written and spoken English Good communication   and technical writing skills Creative and able to work autonomously More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.
